title: The playhouse sausage filled Gilbert’s soul.
html_source: See the earlier line: “Canvasclimbers who sailed with Drake chew their sausages among the groundlings.” Stephen gives Gilbert a hick accent and places him with the groundlings, apparently not having much esteem for him.
